memory_candidates.text: Lean 4: section-variable hypotheses (e.g. `(hb : ∀ t u, R t b u → u = b)`) are only included in a theorem if its statement mentions them; pass them as explicit arguments when only some theorems need them, rather than `include`, to avoid unused-section-variable noise.
FrameOver.ofSlicedStep_step's clause is `R p.1 p.2 q.2` at the state's own slice time; a lemma about an arbitrary history must be stated at `(σ.state z).1`, not `z`, since histories may be offset.

The HWZ-verbatim quasistate shape (per-time realized closure types + consecutive-type relation) does not determine the seam's realized family triples `Hit`: wired probe quasistate-does-not-determine-hit.lean; a per-model realizability bridge must carry joint realization through the seam.
